remarks: Welcome to this stunningly remodeled three bedroom condo. Featuring kitchen with elegant shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, and high-end stainless steel appliances. Two beautiful modern tiled bathrooms. The open living space boasts 9' ceilings and hardwood floors throughout. Reserved garage space, along with plenty of visitor parking in the rear lot. Located within walking distance to a variety of restaurants and shops. Rent includes cooking gas, water and heat. Excellent credit is a must. Available May 1st.
